tool_args.rationale: The evidence points to the coupled memory ODE, but its four parameters remain underidentified from the five initial rows. The authorized guidance specifies obtaining at least eight trajectories before fitting; the extra fine trajectory batch is therefore the relevant next measurement.

It does not supply the additional trajectories specified as necessary to identify the coupled ODE parameters.
